item.title: Can 'Em All
item.description:
Title: Can 'Em All
Genre: Action , Indie , Simulation , Strategy
Developer: LuisDev
Publisher: LuisDev
Release Date: Oct 30, 2026




About This Game

Oh look, the truck is here.

A truck delivers a fresh batch of adorable creatures straight to your factory.

Unfortunately for them, they're also your main source of income.

First, you need them dead.

Grab your weapons and clear out the factory.

Now turn them into something useful.

Grab the bodies and throw them into the crusher.

Get those cans into the tube.

Your freshly processed cans still need to be sold.

Reinvest in the business.

Get stronger weapons. Upgrade your vacuum. Unlock machines. Build conveyors. Increase production. Bring in more creatures. Automate the factory.

item.title: Queen's Domain
item.description:
Title: Queen's Domain
Genre: Action , Adventure , Indie , RPG
Developer: Freshly Baked Games LLC
Publisher: Future Friends Games
Release Date: Oct 30, 2026




About This Game

Queen’s Domain is a retro-fantasy action RPG. Washed up on the shores of the Isle of Neasied, you set out to find your father and uncover the dark heart of this mysterious isle.

Wield the Legendary Holy Sword Endu to take flight from platform to platform, and discover an interconnected, labyrinthine world where secrets and dangers lurk around every corner.

Fight action-oriented battles with a classic stamina meter, powerful charge attacks, weapon specific special attacks, and secondary throwing weapons. Level up, accessorize, and choose from a huge catalogue of melee weapons on your quest to fight your way through the hordes of monsters and powerful bosses awaiting you in the darkest depths of the isle.

Features:

  • Explore an interconnected island filled with hidden secrets

  • Lovingly crafted retro-fantasy aesthetic

  • Action-combat with a stamina meter, special attacks, throwing weapons & more

  • Fly across gaps with your Holy Sword – use upgrades to fly further!

  • Dozens of hours of adventuring and exploration

  • 50+ melee weapons to discover, equip, and upgrade

  • Use XP to level up, and eat delicious food to further increase your stats

  • 20+ types of secondary throwing weapons allow for varied strategies in combat

  • Over 100 enemies, mini bosses, and bosses to defeat

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Contains depictions of blood and skeletons



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: Intel Core i5 quad core, 2.5ghz
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 760 / AMD RX 560
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 1500 MB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: Intel Core i5 quad core, 3.5ghz
    • Memory: 6 GB RAM
    • Graphics: GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 1500 MB available space

item.title: Totally Safe Moon Project
item.description:
Title: Totally Safe Moon Project
Genre: Simulation
Developer: Fake Moon
Publisher: rokaplay select
Release Date: Oct 30, 2026




About This Game

No AI was used in the development of this game!!!

A giant asteroid is about to destroy the Earth!

Play solo or in online co-op with up to 3 friends! Build a tower all the way to the Moon, deliver a powerful laser, and save humanity before it's too late!

Build a Tower

Your goal is the Moon!

To get there - use anything you can find to build the tallest tower, from fences and boxes to houses and clouds.
A Gravity Gun will come in handy...

Upgrade & Go Higher

As you climb higher, you earn rewards like new abilities, items, or points used to upgrade your gear.

The higher you go, the crazier skills you get.

Bring the Laser

Once the tower is ready - work together to bring the laser you built in your garage to the top and explode that rock!'

Totally Safe Moon Project is all about shared moments, creativity, and joyful chaos. There is no competition and no pressure, just teamwork and the simple question of how far you can get together.

Features:

  • Build a totally safe tower to the Moon!

item.title: Rat Game
item.description:
Title: Rat Game
Genre: Action , Indie
Developer: Sokpop Collective
Publisher: Sokpop Collective
Release Date: Oct 30, 2026




About This Game

OVERVIEW 📙

  • Asymmetrical online co-op with 1 Chef vs 2 to 7 Rats

  • Play against a human or robot-controlled Chef

  • Interconnected map filled with tasks & secrets

  • Around 3 hours of playtime

OH, RATS!!!!!!!!!🐀

Chef has been trying to exterminate the rats, leaving them no choice but to ruin his restaurant. Crawl through hidden shortcuts and hide in dark corners in a vast human-scale map. Work in teams of 2-8 to nibble through wires, clog the toilet, hack the PC – anything to get this place shut down for good!

YOU’RE COOKED!!!!!!👨‍🍳

Rats are destroying your treasured family restaurant. Stomp around listening for the tell-tale sound of scrabbling claws, waiting for the right moment to grab them and throw them in the cage. If all else fails, you also have a gun. Time for some pest control!

DEFEAT THE ROBO-CHEF!!!! 🤖

Co-op only mode sets you and your rat friends against the mighty mechanical Robo-Chef. He’s programmed to cook, clean… and to kill!

Rat Game is an asymmetrical comedy horror with a dynamic soundtrack, an interconnected map, squeaky proximity chat, and plenty of cheese. Last one standing wins.

item.title: The Electorate
item.description:
Title: The Electorate
Genre: Simulation , Strategy
Developer: Galactic Interactive
Publisher: Galactic Interactive
Release Date: Oct 29, 2026




About This Game

The Ultimate Election Simulator

Run a complete campaign, from primaries to the general election, across a living political map of the United States. Over 3,000 counties are modeled with real-world demographics, party registrations, and ideological positions, creating endless possibilities. Every rally, speech, and advertisement impacts the number of votes you'll get.

Run For President, Congress, or Governor

Each campaign features thousands of real-life and randomly generated characters with unique backgrounds, personalities, traits, and attributes. Campaign as any of them, or your own character, to become the next President of the United States or the Governor of Florida. The choice is yours.

Plan Your Strategy

Plan your weekly moves and adapt to new conditions. Open field offices, build volunteer networks, buy advertisements, hire staff, and schedule events in any county and state you see fit. But don't run out of money!

Unpredictable Events

No race is the same. Debates, scandals, endorsements, and breaking news can swing the polls overnight. Your opponents will react to your tactics and counter with strategies that match their political style, strengths, and weaknesses.

Real-Life and Custom Candidates

Play as a real politician or create a custom candidate. Select unique traits and attributes that affect your campaign’s strengths and vulnerabilities. Will you charm voters as Barack Obama? Dominate the airwaves as Donald Trump? Or brutally attack your rivals with your own candidate? The choice is yours.

Dynamic Polls

Track your progress with several in-game pollsters who take new polls every week. Every poll could be wildly inaccurate or right on the money. You truly won't know who's going to win until Election Day.

Election Night Drama

Experience the tension of the results coming in live, state by state, county by county. Watch the map shift in real time as votes are counted and momentum swings. Every decision you made on the trail culminates in this moment. Will you see a glorious victory? Or suffer a shocking upset?

An Election Sandbox

Play through historical scenarios with real-world data. Can you defeat Ronald Reagan as Jimmy Carter? Win as Ross Perot in 1992? Predict the future in 2028? The Electorate comes with 12 official scenarios.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

AI was used to help localize text in the game.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
    • Processor: 2 GHz Dual-Core Processor
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: DirectX 11-compatible GPU with Shader Model 5.0 support
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 10 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
